steps.title: Add water to plates
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons P20‑single‑channel GEN2 (right mount) with 20 µL filter tips, dispense the custom water volume specified in the CSV into every well of each 96‑well PCR plate (Plate 1‑4) from the NEST 12‑well 15 mL reservoir, using the same tip for the entire plate and mixing each well after addition.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a fresh 20 µL filter tip.
For Plate 1, aspirate the water volume for the current well from the NEST 12‑well 15 mL reservoir (volume taken from the uploaded CSV).
Dispense the aspirated water into the corresponding well of PCR Plate 1.
Repeat the aspirate‑dispense‑mix cycle for all wells of Plate 1 using the same tip.
Discard the tip and repeat the entire process for Plate 2, Plate 3, and Plate 4, each time using a new tip.

steps.title: Pool normalized samples
steps.instruction: Using the same P20‑single‑channel GEN2 pipette and a fresh tip, transfer 5 µL from each well of each normalized PCR plate into the designated tube of the Opentrons 24‑tube rack (Plate 1 → A1, Plate 2 → B1, Plate 3 → C1, Plate 4 → D1), performing a 3‑mix before each dispense.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a fresh 20 µL filter tip.
For Plate 1, aspirate 5 µL from a well.
Mix the aspirated sample 3 times in the tip.
Dispense the mixed 5 µL into tube A1 of the 24‑tube rack.
Repeat the aspirate‑mix‑dispense cycle for every well of Plate 1 using the same tip.
Repeat the entire process for Plate 2 (dispense into B1), Plate 3 (dispense into C1), and Plate 4 (dispense into D1), using a new tip for each plate.
